name: Eternal Ltd
title: Eternal Ltd - 543320 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Quick commerce is pursuing ~60% NOV CAGR over three years with no margin cushion disclosed; management keeps marketing spend high and says competition is not changing its stance, so supply and pricing discipline are unproven.

triggers.label: Competitors pulled back on marketing
triggers.quote: We feel a lot of our competitors in the market have pulled back on this so we're seeing extremely low cost of customer acquisition

triggers.label: Dark stores 3,000 by March; no FY27 store number
triggers.quote: we're not planning to give out any specific number guidance on that

triggers.label: Competitive activity unchanged
triggers.quote: Competitive activity hasn't meaningfully changed from the last time we were on this call.

triggers.label: FY27 growth now not 100%
triggers.quote: Yes, it will not be 100%, but we are not guiding to a specific number.

guidance.quote: We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR
